content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIM Raipur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIM Raipur Research Associate/Project Associate/Consultancy Associate Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 27-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIM Raipur to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIM Raipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications for the Research Associate/Project Associate/Consultancy Associate posts is 27 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in IIM Raipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Research Associate/Project Associate/Consultancy Associate post in the IIM Raipur recruitment drive. This offers a specific opportunity for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Research Associate/Project Associate/Consultancy Associate posts at IIM Raipur is online. Candidates need to visit the official website to fill out and submit their applications.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for IIM Raipur Research Associate posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Research Associate/Project Associate/Consultancy Associate posts is 40 years. Age relaxation will be applicable as per Government of India norms for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Research Associate/Project Associate/Consultancy Associate position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Research Associate/Project Associate/Consultancy Associate position will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 35,000 to Rs. 45,000 per month. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q6. What are the required educational qualifications?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Master’s degree (MSc/M.Tech/MBA) in Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, Operations Research, Mathematics, Business Analytics, Operation Management, Financial Analytics or equivalent from a recognized university. Preference is given to IITs/IIMs/NITs graduates.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for IIM Raipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Research Associate/Project Associate/Consultancy Associate posts. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate/Project Associate/Consultancy Associate positions includes a written test followed by a personal interview. Candidates must clear both stages to be considered for selection.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job location for the Research Associate/Project Associate/Consultancy Associate post is Raipur, Chhattisgarh. IIM Raipur is located in this city, offering a professional work environment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of IIM Raipur?
faq.answer: The official website for Indian Institute of Management Raipur (IIM Raipur) is https://iimraipur.ac.in. All official notifications and application links will be available on this portal.
